answer: A strong sybil defense is behavioral attestation: agents must sustain a long, verifiable history of useful work before earning full trust, so a fresh fake identity cannot pulse through the economy with the same weight as an established one. The network watches each identity's transaction signal over time; clones stand out as a cluster whose patterns are too similar, like one instrument playing every part of an orchestra. Real identities grow into a safe haven of reputation, while sybils stay shallow and correlated, letting peers quarantine clone swarms without punishing honest newcomers.
